title: Private San Diego Segway Fanatic Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have a high level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Are you a segway fanatic? If you have ridden segways numerous times. Skip the training arrive and ride. This tour moves quickly to cover a lot of ground in a short amount of time. With a knowledgeable guide, cruise along the San Diego downtown and urban neighborhoods and see interesting sights along. Check out areas like Balboa Park. The outskirts of Little Italy. The San Diego Embarcadero, with views of Coronado while riding along the bayside waterfront. Making our glide through the popular Gaslamp Quarter.We will cover 12.5 miles in 2.5hrs steady cruisin.
